timing.clock: elapsedMs is relative to action beatTimes.release; caller owns action time
timing.speed: fixed 220 ms flight; distance sets speed; near/far arrivals share contact cue

scaleConvention: scale=1 uses this preview canvas (1280x896): arrow source multiplied by 0.055, crisp length about 71 px; flash 0.052..0.068; trailing wisp 0.025. Root projects the body anchor to canvas and passes its body-to-preview scale. Positions are canvas pixels and never multiplied by scale.

anchors.origin: arrowhead at release, exact action effectAnchors id arrow
anchors.target: projectile arrowhead reaches target at 220 ms; flash center is target

method: Native alpha raster arrow and contact flash from built-in Imagegen; existing native golden wisp reused. Each draw independently positions and turns separate sprites. No character transforms or pixel edits. No geometric substitute for art.
limits: Character motion remains the character worker’s input, including a nocked arrow and RGB matte. Flight does not remove the nocked arrow.
Fixed flight duration is 220 ms for all distances; it is not constant physical speed.
secondaryOrigin is ignored for this single arrow effect.
Native generated alpha includes very faint peripheral pixels; no raster cleanup or extraction is applied.
Continuous smoke is a separate preview layer and is outside this module.
runtimePaths: All local assets resolve against effect.js with URL and Image.decode; no external paths.
